arrival_pending.rule: After own arrival increment, compare unsigned floor(new_counter/10000)>floor(old_counter/10000). If true store floor(new_counter/10000) in pending. Pending stores a quotient, not an event queue/count of notifications.
arrival_pending.effect: Multiple thresholds crossed before midnight coalesce into current pending quotient. No pending change if quotient unchanged.

midnight_priority.first: Reset festival flag0x800cda00=0 each midnight; if month8 and stage/day4 show0x80052270(2,0,0), then flag=1.
midnight_priority.second: If signed pending>0 and festival flag==0: clear pending, draw RNG%2 once and call0x80052dbc(variant). After it returns perform popularity writes.
midnight_priority.preserve: Festival branch leaves pending value unchanged and does not consume the pending-variant RNG draw. Next non-festival midnight can process it.

celebration.population: Use0x8001bd78 own-store ordering, active own stores only, aggregate unsigned wrapped sum of store entered counter+0x1188. This is not read directly from global0x800cd930.
celebration.display_gate: aggregate unsigned>=10000; otherwise returns before image/message/audio.
celebration.number: floor(unsigned aggregate/10000) to0x800cd938. Message471 uses0x4003(width5) then literal 万人目...
celebration.variants: RNG%2 chooses sprite coordinates; both use same MSG471 and number formula.
celebration.duration: 120 timed wait calls followed by optional acknowledgement loop; not a fixed120-frame total or guaranteed2 seconds.
celebration.cash: No cash or ledger posting inside recovered celebration screen.
celebration.parent_effect: After screen returns, for all10 store records: if signed active byte!=0 OR owner bit15 clear then set signed32 popularity+0xc6c=100. The OR is original: active rivals are included; inactive owner0 records are also included. Inactive rival records are skipped.
celebration.early_return: Parent popularity writes run even if screen returned early for aggregate<10000. Do not incorrectly place the parent writes inside the display threshold guard.
celebration.evaluation: No +0xc68 evaluation write in this parent event effect.

festival.text: 今日は夜にお祭りがあります。
festival.duration: 120 timed wait calls in the mode2 screen; previous controlled render proof exists. No new physical audio/GPU claim.
festival.direct_effect: The recovered festival screen is presentation; do not invent cash/popularity bonus from its message.

order: Outer update calls0x800275f8 monthly ads/donations/store ratings before0x80029334 finance/celebration. Donation popularity and later celebration popularity are distinct effects; annual evaluation uses C68, not C6C.
limitations: Isolated controlled display proofs are reused, not counted as new gameplay.
Original initial files have rivals only. No natural surplus-cash or milestone/festival trajectory is asserted.
Calendar stage/day values are retained as original1..4; do not silently substitute Gregorian month day30.
